name: Digital Reference (DR)
summary: Ontology for the semiconductor industry and its supply chains, organised in thematic "lobes" (about 1,200 classes). Introduced in the ECSEL Productive4.0 project.

sources.title: Winter Simulation Conference 2025 paper using DR

verification.notes: Confirm the licence in the repository before reuse.

engineeringUses: Describing semiconductor products, production and supply-chain concepts in a shared vocabulary
Supporting supply-chain data exchange between partners in the semiconductor value chain
